en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning for eastern New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised a thunderstorm warning at 9:30pm, valid until 11:30pm, for isolated storms in the eastern New Territories.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 9:30pm on Thursday, saying isolated thunderstorms were expected in the eastern New Territories. The warning was set to remain in force until 11:30pm.

In its 10:02pm weather report, the Observatory recorded 30 degrees at its headquarters and relative humidity of 78 per cent. The weather icon had shifted from mainly fine to light rain. Earlier in the evening the Observatory had said the day would turn cloudier with a few showers and possible thunderstorms in some areas.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to take shelter in a safe place when thunder is heard, to leave the water and not to swim or take part in other outdoor water sports, and to avoid high ground and objects that conduct electricity, including trees and masts.
A Very Hot Weather Warning and a Yellow Fire Danger Warning remained listed on the Observatory's detailed warning page on Thursday night. Those signals had already been in force earlier in the day.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界東部有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台晚上9時30分發出雷暴警告，有效至晚上11時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。
body: 香港天文台星期四晚上9時30分發出雷暴警告，表示預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴，警告有效時間至晚上11時30分。
天文台晚上10時02分的天氣報告指，總部錄得氣溫30度，相對濕度78%，天氣插圖由天色大致良好轉為微雨。天文台較早時曾表示，晚間會漸轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨，局部地區可能有雷暴。
天文台提醒，雷暴發生時，身處室外的人士應到安全地方躲避；亦應離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動；並避免站立於高地，或接近樹木、桅杆等導電物體。
天文台詳細警告頁面晚間仍列出酷熱天氣警告及黃色火災危險警告。這兩項警告早一段時間已經生效。
